source.title: Baal t’fillah, third expanded edition [1894]
source.creator: Abraham Baer
source.heading: Anwendung in rythmischer (recitativer) Verbindung und zugleich Schluss.

sourceKey.scope: Literal one-flat signature; no modal/traditional or Kinnor identity inferred.

scan.transformation: Lossless WebP encoding of an unretouched grayscale crop. All decoded grayscale pixels compare exactly to the pinned3000px institutional raster converted to grayscale. A4/tempo/articulation interpretation is separate from image provenance.

source.rights: Nineteenth-century print public domain; Frankfurt digitization policy, exceptions retained. New original transcription/code CC0-1.0.

studies.metricalLimit: First eighth is before the first printed barline. The two subsequent source bars each contain two quarter-note beats; no missing beats are padded or inferred from C.

studies.footnote: The printed asterisk points to No46 as a possible third way. No No46 realization or equivalence is inferred.

method: Original literal draft reading of pinned source. Word associations follow explicit verse references and printed Latin lyric positions. Original UXLC marked strings/IDs retained. Source units are not assigned to Hebrew/MAM syllables or phonemes. Upper/lower physical heads remain separate monophonic choices.

performance.writtenRhythms: Regularized quarter-note BPM; source Andante/Recit. carries no numeric tempo.

unmeasuredGraces.default: unavailable when a selected span contains a grace
